content:
Ava L.: Quick plan for Fri deploy (09:30 PT). Rolling update across release lane Marigold: embed-service v2.3 -> router-config -> model-switch. Target 2-min per pod drain.
Ben P.: I'll own smoke for embed-service. Canary at 5% first 10m then 25% if healthy.
Carla M.: I can do router-config; what's the rollback key? <https://redwood/runbooks/marigold-deploy>
Ava L.: Rollback flag is feature_flag=off + helm rollback to release-2026-03-12. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/marigold-deploy
Eliot R.: Dev infra note: DB migrations are out-of-band; no schema changes. Make sure to clear KV cache pre-switch: ```redis-cli -h cache.prod 'KEYS' 'prefix:*' | xargs -r redis-cli -h cache.prod DEL```
Sam K.: Confirming: smoke checklist? I have the scripts and dashboards open.
Ben P.: Smoke script: ```./smoke.sh --service embed-service --endpoint /health --timeout 10s``` run from ci-runner-5; ping here with results.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy 1739993400 by Ava L. -> Marigold lane. Canaries 5/25/100. Watch: /deploy Marigold v2.3
Ava L.: ETA 09:30 PT. If any error, abort and rollback within 15m. Assigning watches: Ben (smoke), Carla (router), Sam (telemetry), Eliot (infra)
Carla M.: ack. I'll be on pager 09:20-10:00 PT :white_check_mark:
Ben P.: Starting smoke at 09:36 if canary passes. Will post short logs.
Sam K.: I'll watch APM dashboards and error-rate alert. Ping me with `@Sam K.` if rates > 1% :warning:
Ben P.: smoke: PASS - all health endpoints green, latencies nominal. Logs: `200 OK` on /health across canary nodes.
Ava L.: Good — proceed to 25% at +10m. Remember to tag commit: `git tag marigold-v2.3-deploy-1739991111`
Eliot R.: infra note: autoscaler tuned to avoid immediate extra nodes; keep an eye on queue depth.
deploy-bot: deploy progress: canary(5%) -> 25% (in-progress)
Carla M.: Router config flipped at 09:48 PT, no 5xx observed.
Ben P.: 25% healthy. Advancing to 100%.
deploy-bot: deploy completed 100% at 09:59 PT. No rollback triggered.
Ava L.: Great work — closing the lane. Postmortem: none required. Quick follow-ups: bump quantization config for model-switch next week.
Sam K.: copied. Logging the runbook link and artifacts: https://redwood/ci/artifacts/1739991111
